reference: User-supplied video frame; video-design.png is a clean reconstruction of its two figures.

design.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent full-body character art for a 2D fighting game.
Edit target: the supplied animation reference frame. Extract and cleanly redraw ONLY the two men, retaining the exact character designs, face shapes, anatomy, clothing colors and smooth hand-inked animation style from this frame.
Output: transparent background, two isolated figures side by side, with wide empty separation and no overlap. Left: the brown-haired man with thin rim glasses, gray business suit, white shirt, red necktie, black formal dress shoes, performing the shown high side kick facing right. Keep one clean kicking leg, remove the trailing duplicate leg / motion smear. Right: the older white-bearded man wearing a cream Panama fedora with a black band, charcoal business suit, white shirt, dark purple/navy tie and small gold tie clip, black formal shoes, facing left in the exact deep wide squat parry pose shown, forward open hand extended diagonally to his left, rear fist by his right hip.
Style: reproduce the reference's smooth 1990s hand-drawn cel animation: thin dark charcoal outlines, graceful full-body anatomy, restrained flat cel shadows and a few soft painted accents. Fully tailored jackets with lapels, believable trouser folds, natural hands and polished dress shoes. These are ordinary suited men performing fighting moves, with exactly the proportions and identity shown in the reference.
Constraints: entire bodies including shoes and hat within frame. Preserve the parrying man's beard and the kicker's glasses. No scene, floor, shadows, blue effects, smoke, ghosts, HUD, words, grid, borders, labels, watermarks. Actual transparent alpha. Do not make pixel art, chibi figures, exaggerated muscles, 3D figures, or photorealistic figures.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production sprite sheet for a 2D illustrated fighting game.
Input image 1: EXACT identity, costume and drawing-style reference for the two suited men. Input image 2: STRICT nine-cell (3 columns x 3 rows) pose/layout template.
Primary request: Replace each figure in image 2 with the CHARACTER specified below, in precisely that cell's pose and orientation. Follow the template's shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle positions and facing direction. Preserve poses, including crouching, airborne, and turned-away views. Use the template solely for anatomy and animation; completely redraw the figure as the suited reference man.
Style: clean smooth hand-inked cel animation matching image 1, thin charcoal outlines, restrained flat cel shading, natural anatomy and detailed expressive hands, full tailored business suit with white shirt, proper lapels and dress shoes. Match the reference face faithfully.
Composition: square sprite sheet, exactly 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows, each pose centered in its own cell in the same order as image 2, ample transparent separation. Keep approximately the same figure scale and placement as the template. Each body, hat and every shoe must fit inside its cell; no touching other cells. Background must be true transparent alpha.
Constraints: no labels, grid lines, frames, text, scene, cast shadows, motion trails, effects, watermark, or extra figures. Do not draw any original fighter's skin, hair, gloves, karate clothes, boots or blue dress from the pose template. No pixel art, no oversized muscles, no chibi. These are fully drawn normal-proportioned men in suits. Keep the same suit and face across every cell.
CHARACTER: the OLDER WHITE-BEARDED MAN from the RIGHT of image 1: cream Panama fedora with black band, charcoal almost-black suit jacket and matching trousers, white shirt, dark purple/navy tie with gold tie clip, black formal shoes. He has a full white beard and must wear his hat in every pose.
